meta.title: feat(worker): Implement bulk event sending method
meta.body_summary: Add a /send/bulk endpoint to the socket worker and refactor SocketWorkerService to send multiple event types (message, unread, unseen) in a single HTTP request, reducing network overhead and improving performance.

core_change_summary.description: Added a /send/bulk endpoint in the socket worker that accepts up to 100 messages and returns per-message success/failure status. Refactored SocketWorkerService to combine message, unread count, and unseen count into a single bulk request when handling RECEIVED events with messageId.
